A10 census rules, logged before the script is written or run (G42's order test): (1) each ruled line takes the class it was ruled under, checked against its written decision and kind: instantiate O and M are the order (M also the mechanism in words), J one act, MF move first, NP one end; restrict S-O and S-M the order (S-M in words), S-MF move first, S-MO move only, S-BOUND the bound, S-GU gave up, S-NM no move, S-HELD held, EL evidence limit, P-G6 other; add and contradict lines are no move where the reason says the census counts them so, else held; absent rejects are the order, specifications held, particulars other, the rest limits. (2) A room is counted in each class its lines show, then once by priority: order, move first, bound, one act, gave up, no move, move only, held, one end, el, other, limit. A room whose lines show both the order and move first is resolved by its first acts, the earliest doubt and the earliest move after a loss that its lines cite, and each such room is listed with the two hours. (3) Shares: the order among rooms whose lines order both ends (order, move first, bound), beside C2's 11 of 21 (0.524) and the C5c read, 10 of 20; the same with one-act rooms added; among rooms that show doubt and then a move, giving up or no move, how many moved, beside F-019 (of 36 with doubt and a loss, 10 moved and 11 gave up); and the rooms whose lines show the mechanism in words, as a share of the order rooms. Move-only rooms do not carry both and are reported apart
